_why: K (2026-11-04): the channel must hold only quality work and the burned text must go. Every upload made before the 2026-11-03 14:22 fix carries a drifting lyric sweep (estimated, not measured) that did not match the sung line, plus a title card and a closing card. The renderers no longer burn any text, so the corrected files in library/ (and on the media-938 release) are the replacement. Each replacement costs one upload slot, so they drain at the leftover quota of the Pacific day (07:00 UTC reset) before new releases.
